title: Saeima changes its mind about Latvian citizenship for Indian scientist
summary_full: Just one week after it voted to award Latvian citizenship to Indian scientist Divya Kannan Vishwanath, Latvia's parliament, the Saeima, performed a massive U-turn and voted to revoke her citizenship on October 22nd.
